content: Do that which is assigned you, and you cannot hope too much or dare too much.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: When you align your daily actions with your true, authentic vocation, the natural laws of the universe rush to back your courageous efforts.
practicalInsight: Identify your true work and execute it with total, fearless commitment.
reflectionPrompt: What is the primary task or craft currently assigned to your talents and conscience?
